title: Peptide nucleic acid \(PNA) fluorescent _in situ_ hybridization \(FISH) on chromosomes in suspension for analysis of repetitive DNA by flow cytometry
protocol: Culture cells according to specific procedure for the cell type.
Replace media in approximately 75% confluent cultures.
Allow cells to grow for 2 hours.
Add 0.1 μg/ml of Colcemid to cell cultures.
Incubate with Colcemid for 3 to 4 hours.
Collect mitotic cells by shake off.
Rinse the plates with their media for 3 to 4 times for CHO and C166 cells.
Tap the flasks vigorously for HT1080 cells.
Spin down the harvested cells at 350 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the media from the tube.
Disturb the cell pellet by flicking the tube.
Re-suspend the cell pellet slowly while adding hypotonic solution and swirling the tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 to 15 minutes.
Stain an aliquot of cells with propidium iodide during the incubation time for hypotonic treatment.
Calculate the mitotic index using a fluorescent microscope.
Spin down the cells at 350 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the hypotonic solution from the tube.
Flick the tube to disturb the cell pellet carefully.
Re-suspend the cell pellet by slowly adding ice-cold chromosome isolation buffer (1 ml per 200,000 harvested mitotic cells).
Incubate on ice for 15 to 30 minutes.
Vortex vigorously for 75 seconds to liberate chromosomes from mitotic cells.
Set water bath to 80°C and pre-warm 100 µl of hybridization solution per condition tested.
Treat chromosome suspensions with 100 U ml^-1^ of RNAse T1 for 20 minutes at room temperature (18-25°C).
Spin down chromosomes at 350 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Disturb the pellet by flicking the tube.
Add 100 µl of hybridization mixture to the chromosome pellet.
Mix very gently.
Immersed the chromosome suspension in a water bath at 80°C for 5 minutes.
Hybridize at room temperature (18-25°C) for 60 minutes.
Pre-warm 1 ml of wash solution per hybridization tube at 37°C during the hybridization time.
Add 500 µl of wash solution to chromosomes in hybridization solution after hybridization.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Spin down the chromosomes at 1675 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant, leaving behind 100 μl.
Repeat steps i to iii.
Re-suspend hybridized chromosomes in chromosome isolation buffer containing chromomycin A3 and Hoechst 33258.
Filter chromosome samples using a 35 µm cell strainer cap tube.
Tap the strainer tube gently to filter.
Adjust the Cy5 PMT power to 50 mW.
Load the sample and adjust the PMT power generally between 35-40 mW for Hoechst 33259 and 45-50 mW for chromomycin A3 on the instrument.
Analyze 50,000 to 100,000 events per sample.
Gate out debris on a pulse width versus chromomycin A3 plot.
Repeat gating process on a pulse width versus Hoechst 33258 plot.
Plot bivariate Hoechst 33258 versus chromomycin A3 flow karyograms.
Plot Cy5 versus chromomycin A3 density plots.
